final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS c FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.k AS k, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.total, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.k, s3.c, s3.ratio, s3.c - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.a
